title: TUI spec-check screen: show a permission call's whole command
lead: *Proposed.* The spec-check screen shows a pending permission question's `detail` the same way S373's run pane does.
findings_note: S373 (2026-11-16): the run pane shows a permission question's `detail` in full; the spec-check screen still shows only the 120-character title. Owner decision adj 377 (`ui.permission-detail-speccheck`, follow-up).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: *Proposed.* The owner answers spec-check permission questions from that screen too; a cut command cannot be judged.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - `TestSpecCheckPermissionQuestionShowsDetail`: a spec-check permission question with a 300-character detail renders the whole detail, wrapped, under its title (golden).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Red test, then the view, reusing S373's rendering.
2. Docs: `docs/dashboard.md`. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.
